result.reasoning: This commit introduced the `savedFilteringAndGrouping` mechanism along with the code path that unconditionally sets `savedFilteringAndGrouping = null` after triggering global optimization (`if (doGlobalOpt) { ... globalOptPopup.doClick(); } savedFilteringAndGrouping = null;`), regardless of whether global optimization actually consumed it. This unconditional discard is exactly what the fix commit corrects by moving the discard into an `else` branch. The later commit acef72c39cbf made global optimization asynchronous, which exposed/exacerbated the race, but the core buggy logic of discarding the saved filtering/grouping without regard to the async global-opt flow was introduced in 4516bc398890.
